boundary: Interpretive naming metaphors only. These strings are not evidence of company priorities, bottlenecks, affiliation, adoption, or etymological authority.

onomastics.palantir: A far-seeing stone — a metaphor for visibility that still needs coherent interpretation.
onomastics.anduril: A reforged blade — a metaphor for power that remains bounded by the hand directing it.
onomastics.cerebras: A brain-shaped name — a metaphor for specialized parts coordinating as one system.
onomastics.oracle: An answer-giving figure — a metaphor for answers that also need authority, provenance, and rollback.
onomastics.anthropic: Human-centered language — a metaphor for capability remaining subordinate to human authority.
onomastics.mistral: A strong wind — a metaphor for speed and sovereignty without losing governance.
onomastics.snowflake: A unique crystal — a metaphor for fine-grained identity, permissions, and lineage.
onomastics.coreweave: A woven core — a metaphor for matching heterogeneous compute threads to the right workload.
onomastics.databricks: Bricks of data — a metaphor for governance that remains structural when agents act on top of it.
onomastics.adobe: A building material — a metaphor for preserving creative intent, history, and provenance.
onomastics.blue_origin: A return to origin — a metaphor for reusable systems whose state must survive the full cycle.
onomastics.cloudflare: A flare at the cloud edge — a metaphor for authority and state that must hold globally.
onomastics.cohere: To hold together — a metaphor for context that stays high-signal enough to remain useful.
onomastics.groq: To understand deeply — a metaphor for understanding delivered under extreme latency pressure.
onomastics.deepseek: Seeking deeply — a metaphor for routing, memory, and observability remaining coherent as depth grows.
onomastics.notion: An idea — a metaphor for turning scattered knowledge into governed action.
onomastics.manus: A hand — a metaphor for autonomous reach that stays bounded, checkpointed, and reversible.
onomastics.qwen: A thousand questions — a metaphor for matching heterogeneous requests to the right capability.
onomastics.openai: Openness — a metaphor for capability that remains dependable, inspectable, and controllable.
onomastics.spacex: Space plus an unknown — a metaphor for coherent mission state across radically different clocks.
onomastics.xai: An unknown variable — a metaphor for finding the next system constraint rather than optimizing one subsystem forever.
onomastics.tesla: Electrical motion — a metaphor for perception and control streams that cannot tolerate silent gaps.
onomastics.lockheed_martin: Mission systems — a metaphor for telemetry, state, confidence, authority, human decision, execution, and receipt.
onomastics.nasa: Exploration under constraint — a metaphor for autonomy operating inside hard safety boundaries.
onomastics.glaciereq_core: Ice in equilibrium — a metaphor for a large layered system that preserves its record while it evolves.
